Common.name: Backfire
Common.desc: If a face-up FIRE monster(s) you control is destroyed and sent to the GY: Inflict 500 damage to your opponent.

Common.name: Blazing Inpachi
Common.desc: A wicked wooden spirit now burning in flames. Its fire attack is powerful, but it will soon be nothing but ashes.

Common.name: Call of the Haunted
Common.desc: Activate this card by targeting 1 monster in your GY; Special Summon that target in Attack Position. When this card leaves the field, destroy that monster. When that monster is destroyed, destroy this card.

Common.name: Dark Room of Nightmare
Common.desc: Each time your opponent takes damage from a card effect, except "Dark Room of Nightmare", inflict 300 damage to your opponent.

Common.name: Dust Tornado
Common.desc: Target 1 Spell/Trap your opponent controls; destroy that target, then you can Set 1 Spell/Trap from your hand.

Common.name: Fox Fire
Common.desc: During the End Phase, if this card was destroyed by battle and sent to the Graveyard this turn and was face-up at the start of the Damage Step: Special Summon this card from the Graveyard. This face-up card cannot be Tributed for a Tribute Summon.

Common.name: Gaia Soul the Combustible Collective
Common.desc: Once per turn: You can Tribute up to 2 Pyro-Type monsters; this card gains 1000 ATK for each. If this card attacks a Defense Position monster, inflict piercing battle damage to your opponent. During the End Phase: Destroy this card.

Common.name: Great Angus
Common.desc: A very violent beast, it is always berserk. People say that they have never seen it silent.

Common.name: Heavy Storm
Common.desc: Destroy all Spell and Trap Cards on the field.

Common.name: Inferno
Common.desc: Cannot be Normal Summoned/Set. Must first be Special Summoned (from your hand) by banishing 1 FIRE monster from your GY. If this card destroys an opponent's monster by battle and sends it to the GY: Inflict 1500 damage to your opponent.

Common.name: Jar of Greed
Common.desc: Draw 1 card.

Common.name: Level Limit - Area B
Common.desc: Change all face-up Level 4 or higher monsters to Defense Position.

Common.name: Little Chimera
Common.desc: All FIRE monsters on the field gain 500 ATK. All WATER monsters on the field lose 400 ATK.

Common.name: Meteor of Destruction
Common.desc: If your opponent's Life Points are higher than 3000: Inflict 1000 damage to your opponent.

Common.name: Molten Destruction
Common.desc: All FIRE monsters gain 500 ATK and lose 400 DEF.

Common.name: Molten Zombie
Common.desc: When this card is Special Summoned from the Graveyard: Draw 1 card.

Common.name: Mystical Space Typhoon
Common.desc: Target 1 Spell/Trap on the field; destroy that target.

Common.name: Necklace of Command
Common.desc:
When a monster you control that's equipped with this card is destroyed by battle, and this card is sent to the Graveyard, you can either:
● Draw 1 card. OR
● Discard 1 random card from your opponent's hand.

Common.name: Nobleman of Crossout
Common.desc: Target 1 face-down monster on the field; destroy that target, and if you do, banish it, then, if it was a Flip monster, each player reveals their Main Deck, then banishes all cards from it with that monster's name.

Common.name: Pot of Greed
Common.desc: Draw 2 cards.

Common.name: Premature Burial
Common.desc: Activate this card by paying 800 LP, then target 1 monster in your Graveyard; Special Summon that target in Attack Position and equip it with this card. When this card is destroyed, destroy the equipped monster.

Common.name: Raging Flame Sprite
Common.desc: This card can attack your opponent directly. If this card inflicts battle damage to your opponent by a direct attack: This card gains 1000 ATK.

Common.name: Reload
Common.desc: Add all cards in your hand to your Deck and shuffle it. Then draw the same number of cards that you added to your Deck.

Common.name: Snatch Steal
Common.desc: Equip only to a monster your opponent controls. Take control of the equipped monster. During each of your opponent's Standby Phases: They gain 1000 Life Points.

Common.name: Solar Flare Dragon
Common.desc: While you control another Pyro-Type monster, this card cannot be attacked. During each of your End Phases: Inflict 500 damage to your opponent.

Common.name: Spell Shield Type-8
Common.desc:
Activate 1 of these effects.
● When a Spell Card is activated that targets exactly 1 monster on the field: Negate the activation, and if you do, destroy it.
● When a Spell Card is activated: Send 1 Spell Card from your hand to the Graveyard; negate the activation, and if you do, destroy it.

Common.name: Thestalos the Firestorm Monarch
Common.desc: If this card is Tribute Summoned: Discard 1 random card from your opponent's hand, then, if it was a Monster Card, inflict damage to your opponent equal to its original Level x 100.

Common.name: Tribute to the Doomed
Common.desc: Discard 1 card, then target 1 monster on the field; destroy it.

Common.name: UFO Turtle
Common.desc: When this card is destroyed by battle and sent to the Graveyard: You can Special Summon 1 FIRE monster with 1500 or less ATK from your Deck, in face-up Attack Position.

Common.name: Ultimate Baseball Kid
Common.desc: This card gains 1000 ATK for each face-up FIRE monster on the field, except this card. You can send 1 other face-up FIRE monster you control to the Graveyard; inflict 500 damage to your opponent.

Ultra Rare.name: Infernal Flame Emperor
Ultra Rare.desc: This card cannot be Special Summoned. When this card is Tribute Summoned, you can remove from play up to 5 FIRE monsters in your Graveyard. Destroy a number of Spell/Trap Cards on the field equal to the number of monsters removed from play for this effect.
